home.introTitle: Thoughtfully Paced, Privately Guided, Deeply Local.
home.introBody: Sri Lanka rewards unhurried travel. In just a few hours, ancient stone kingdoms give way to cool highland tea estates, leopard-inhabited wilderness, and tranquil Indian Ocean coves. Every itinerary is designed as a quiet dialogue between place, comfort, and personal curiosity.

home.destinationsHeading: Twelve Remarkable Corners of Sri Lanka
home.destinationsSummary: Select a destination on the interactive island map or explore the curated collection below to discover seasons, landscapes, and signature highlights.

destinations.name: Sigiriya
destinations.shortDescription: Fifth-century rock fortress rising dramatically above symmetric water gardens and emerald forest.
destinations.detailedDescription: Rising nearly 200 metres above the central plains, Sigiriya blends ancient urban planning, vivid cliffside frescoes, and sweeping sunrise panoramas across the Cultural Triangle.
destinations.highlights: Sunrise Lion Rock climb | Pidurangala viewpoint | Ancient water gardens | Minneriya elephant gatherings

destinations.name: Ella
destinations.shortDescription: Misty mountain village celebrated for the Nine Arch Bridge, cloud-kissed ridges, and scenic rail journeys.
destinations.detailedDescription: Perched along the southern rim of the central highlands, Ella invites slow mornings overlooking dramatic ravines, gentle hikes to Little Adam's Peak, and scenic train passages through tea valleys.
destinations.highlights: Nine Arch Bridge | Little Adam's Peak | Ella Rock trail | Scenic highland rail journey

destinations.name: Kandy
destinations.shortDescription: Sri Lanka's last royal capital, encircling a tranquil lake beneath forested mountain slopes.
destinations.detailedDescription: Home to the revered Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and lush Peradeniya Botanical Gardens, Kandy links the ancient Cultural Triangle with the winding roads of tea country.
destinations.highlights: Temple of the Sacred Tooth | Kandy Lake twilight walk | Royal Botanical Gardens | Kandyan heritage arts

destinations.name: Nuwara Eliya
destinations.shortDescription: Crisp highland tea estates, misty waterfalls, and whitewashed colonial planters' bungalows.
destinations.detailedDescription: Surrounded by emerald tea slopes at over 1,800 metres, Nuwara Eliya offers private estate tastings, roaring misty cascades, and fireside evenings in timeless heritage residences.
destinations.highlights: Private Ceylon tea tasting | Horton Plains plateau | Heritage planter bungalows | Gregory Lake

destinations.name: Galle
destinations.shortDescription: Seventeenth-century fortified coastal town of coral-stone lanes, boutiques, and sunset ramparts.
destinations.detailedDescription: A living UNESCO World Heritage monument where Dutch colonial mansions house intimate boutique hotels, artisan jewellery studios, spice courtyards, and breezy verandah cafes.
destinations.highlights: Galle Fort sunset ramparts | Historic lighthouse | Boutique architecture walks | Southern cinnamon estates

destinations.name: Mirissa
destinations.shortDescription: Crescent golden bay, palm-fringed headlands, and seasonal offshore whale-watching waters.
destinations.detailedDescription: Framed by dramatic coastal promontories and serene coves, Mirissa balances relaxed tropical ocean days with refined cliffside dining and seasonal Indian Ocean marine excursions.
destinations.highlights: Coconut Tree Hill sunrise | Secluded southern coves | Seasonal marine sightings | Beachfront dining

destinations.name: Yala
destinations.shortDescription: Coastal dry-zone wilderness renowned for Sri Lankan leopards, elephants, and secluded safari camps.
destinations.detailedDescription: Bordering the Indian Ocean, Yala's mosaic of monsoon forest, scrubland, granite outcrops, and lagoons creates one of Asia's most rewarding private game-drive landscapes.
destinations.highlights: Private dawn & dusk game drives | Leopard & sloth bear habitat | Coastal tented lodges | Guided naturalist tracking

destinations.name: Bentota
destinations.shortDescription: Wide golden sands, tranquil river lagoons, and Geoffrey Bawa's celebrated tropical modernist estates.
destinations.detailedDescription: An effortless coastal retreat south of Colombo combining serene beaches, mangrove river safaris, Lunuganga estate visits, and restful Ayurveda spa sanctuaries.
destinations.highlights: Lunuganga country estate | Bentota lagoon boat rides | Wide sunset shoreline | Ayurveda sanctuaries

destinations.name: Arugam Bay
destinations.shortDescription: Sun-drenched eastern surf bay surrounded by wildlife lagoons and peaceful palm coastlines.
destinations.detailedDescription: As the southwest experiences summer rains, Arugam Bay opens into long sunny days, rhythmic right-hand point breaks, Pottuvil lagoon birdlife, and laid-back boutique retreats.
destinations.highlights: Sunrise surf swells | Pottuvil mangrove lagoon | Kumana National Park nearby | East coast serenity

destinations.name: Trincomalee
destinations.shortDescription: Crystalline turquoise bays, Nilaveli white sands, and historic cliffside harbour panoramas.
destinations.detailedDescription: One of the world's deepest natural harbours, Trincomalee pairs powder-soft beaches and calm snorkelling waters with coastal heritage landmarks overlooking the Bay of Bengal.
destinations.highlights: Nilaveli & Uppuveli sands | Pigeon Island reef waters | Koneswaram cliff headland | Calm summer seas

destinations.name: Anuradhapura
destinations.shortDescription: Expansive ancient sacred city of monumental white stupas, carved stone pools, and Bodhi shrines.
destinations.detailedDescription: Sri Lanka's first ancient capital stretches across serene parkland dotted with millennia-old monastic ruins, lotus-filled reservoirs, and peaceful cycling lanes.
destinations.highlights: Monumental white dagobas | Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi | Mihintale hill sanctuary | Guided cycling heritage tour

destinations.name: Jaffna
destinations.shortDescription: Distinct northern peninsula of ornate Dravidian temples, palmyra groves, and coral-island causeways.
destinations.detailedDescription: Offering a vibrant cultural counterpoint to southern Sri Lanka, Jaffna captivates curious travellers with colourful temple architecture, aromatic northern cuisine, and tranquil lagoons.
destinations.highlights: Nallur heritage architecture | Northern culinary traditions | Delft & lagoon islands | Palmyra coastal landscapes

travelTips.title: Understanding Sri Lanka's Two Seasons
travelTips.body: The South, West, and Hill Country are typically driest from November to April, while the East Coast (Trincomalee and Arugam Bay) shines from May to September.

travelTips.title: Pacing & Scenic Transfers
travelTips.body: Although the island is compact, winding highland roads reward relaxed travel days. Limiting stays to 2–3 nights per region keeps journeys effortless.

travelTips.title: Responsible Wildlife & Cultural Etiquette
travelTips.body: Keep respectful distances during wildlife drives and dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered when visiting sacred Buddhist or Hindu shrines.

travelTips.title: Entry Requirements & Travel Health
travelTips.body: Visa, Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA), and health entry rules can change. Always confirm current requirements with official Sri Lankan immigration sources before departure.

home.faqSummary: Helpful neutral guidance on how bespoke Sri Lankan journeys are planned and personalised.

faqs.question: Can every sample itinerary be customised to our dates and pace?
faqs.answer: Yes. The signature itineraries on this website are starting inspirations. You can adjust the duration, destinations, hotel category, and daily pace during your consultation.

faqs.question: Are private airport transfers and chauffeur-guides available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private air-conditioned vehicles with dedicated chauffeur-guides can be arranged from arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport through departure.

faqs.question: Can you arrange boutique hotels, luxury villas, and eco-lodges?
faqs.answer: Yes. Accommodation recommendations can be tailored across boutique heritage properties, tea estate bungalows, wildlife lodges, and beachfront retreats based on your budget.

faqs.question: How do I request a tailor-made quotation?
faqs.answer: Use the Quick Trip Planner or the Tailor-Made Enquiry section to outline your preferred dates, party size, and interests, then send your summary via email or WhatsApp for a personalised proposal.

faqs.question: Do you organise multi-generational family holidays and honeymoons?
faqs.answer: Yes. Routes can be paced specifically for families travelling with children, couples celebrating honeymoons, or private small groups seeking specialist interests.

faqs.question: Can I choose my own travel dates throughout the year?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because Sri Lanka benefits from two distinct monsoon patterns, private journeys can be planned year-round by pairing the sunniest coast with the highlands and Cultural Triangle.
